item.title: Lady Cougars go to 4-0, beat Northside
item.description: Staff Report Pulaski County’s Lady Cougars basketball team won their fourth game of the season Wednesday, defeating Northside, 60-50. The Lady Cougars are now 4-0 on the season. The girls play again Thursday night at Blacksburg. More on the Northside victory later.
